blocks.heading: Adobe Firefly cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Adobe Firefly against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Firefly Standard, Firefly Pro, Firefly for Teams / Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (image generation, ad creative generation, projects, GPTs, and memory) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Standalone pricing is easy to confuse with Creative Cloud Pro bundles

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Distinctive ‘art direction’ still often trails Midjourney for some styles

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not an LLM assistant or coding IDE
